FactMap Scholar — Adaptive UI Design Specification & Component Library

Responsive web & mobile interface specification for automatic scientific claim extraction and NLI-based evidence verification. Includes 3 device variants (Mobile 375px, Tablet 768px, Desktop 1440px), foldable/4K scaling rules, WCAG 2.1 Level AA color contrast tokens, and a reusable component library with all interactive states.

03 · Reusable Component Library & Interactive States

Live Route: /design-system · frontend/src/components/common/
Component Showcase — Live Rendered UI Kit1440 × 980 · Light Theme

Interactive State Specification (Required by Rubric)

Default Hover Focus Active Disabled Error
ComponentDocumented States
ButtonDefault, Hover, Focus-Visible (2px ring), Active (1px press), Loading (spinner + aria-busy), Disabled
Input / SelectDefault, Hover, Focus (3px soft halo), Filled, Error (red border + role="alert"), Disabled
Badgeentailment, contradiction, neutral, success, info, warning, error
SkeletonAnimated shimmer placeholders (title, line, block) for all async fetches
Toast / ModalARIA polite notification queue (info/success/warning/error) & Escape-dismissible dialog
Automated Verification: Playwright suite e2e/adaptive.spec.ts asserts every mobile button and nav control renders at ≥ 44px height and produces 0px horizontal overflow even at 125% text scale.

04 · Screen 01 — Authentication (/login) · 3 Device Variants

Components: AuthForm, Input, Button, Tabs, AlertBanner
Desktop Variant — Split Editorial Layout1440 × 900
Tablet Variant — Stacked Vertical Flow768 × 1024
Mobile Variant — Single Column375 × 812
Adaptation Notes: Two-column split grid on Desktop (≥1024px) collapses smoothly to a single-column vertical flow on Tablet and Mobile. All form controls enforce 44px height and accessible inline validation messages.

05 · Screen 02 — Research Projects (/projects) · 3 Device Variants

Components: AppShell, ProjectTable, CreateProjectForm, Modal, MobileBottomNav
Desktop — Sidebar + Sortable Data Table1440 × 900
Tablet — Compact Topbar + Bottom Nav768 × 1024
Mobile — Card Stack + Bottom Nav375 × 812
Structural Adaptation: Desktop displays a persistent left sidebar and multi-column sortable table. Below 768px, the table automatically transforms into touch-friendly cards paired with a one-hand bottom tab bar.

06 · Screen 03 — Evidence Map Workspace (/projects/:id) · 3 Device Variants

Components: DocumentUploader, AnalysisProgress, EvidenceMap, ClaimsTable, ClaimDetailDrawer
Desktop — Interactive SVG Graph + Claim Inspector1440 × 900
Tablet — Stacked Graph & Filters768 × 1024
Mobile — Card-First Claims View375 × 812
Domain Adaptation: On Desktop, the Evidence Map sits side-by-side with the Claim Detail Inspector. On Mobile (<768px), the workspace defaults to the scannable Claims Card list while allowing instant switching to the interactive pan/zoom graph.

07 · Dark Theme, Display Scale & Automatic Device Detection (/settings)

Hook: useDeviceProfile() · Theme Tokens · Text Scale 90%–125%
Desktop Dark Theme — High-Contrast NLI Palette1440 × 900 · Dark
Settings — Live Device Profile & Health1440 × 900 · Light

Maximum Criteria Highlights: Automatic useDeviceProfile() hook detects viewport tier, DPR, orientation, and aspect ratio in real time. Users customize light/dark theme and typography scale (90%–125%) with persisted preferences.
